set system host-name client001.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set system services ssh root-login deny.command: set system services ssh root-login deny
set system services ssh root-login deny.explanation: Configure SSH services, prohibiting root users from login.

parameters.name: root-login
parameters.explanation: Whether or not to control root users can log in through SSH and Deny says no.

set system login user <username>.explanation: This command fragment configures a user account on a Junos device, where `[parameter1]` specifies the username for login authentication and management access.

authentication plain-text-password.explanation: The command `authentication plain-text-password` sets a plain-text password for user authentication, which is then hashed and stored securely in the configuration.

set system services ssh protocol-version.command: set system services ssh protocol-version v2
set system services ssh protocol-version.explanation: Configure the protocol version used for SSH services.

parameters.name: protocol-version
parameters.explanation: SSH protocol version, v2 indicates use of SSH version 2.

unit 0.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address 10.1.2.2/16.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.
